purpose: ONNX op names and TFLite builtin op names differ. This maps the common ONNX
operators onto the TFLite name the Edge TPU table uses, so an ONNX model can
be checked before anyone spends a day on the conversion toolchain.
caveat: This is a pre-conversion estimate, not the compiler's verdict. A real
TFLite converter fuses, folds and rewrites, so the final graph is not a
one-to-one image of the ONNX graph. Ops marked 'depends' cannot be resolved
from the op name alone and are reported as unknown rather than guessed.

depends.Resize: ResizeBilinear or ResizeNearestNeighbor depending on the 'mode' attribute. Both are supported, but both carry the 3-dimensional tensor limitation.
depends.Clip: Lowers to ReLU6 only when the bounds are exactly 0 and 6. Any other bounds have no Edge TPU equivalent.
depends.BatchNormalization: Normally folded into the preceding Conv during conversion. If it survives folding there is no Edge TPU equivalent and it becomes the cut point.

known_unsupported.Div: No Div in the Edge TPU table. Add, Sub, Mul are supported, Div is not.
known_unsupported.LeakyRelu: Not in the table. PReLU is supported, LeakyRelu is not.
known_unsupported.Gather: Not in the table. Common in embedding lookups and NMS post-processing.
known_unsupported.Shape: Not in the table. Frequent in dynamic-shape graphs.
known_unsupported.Erf: Not in the table. Appears in exact GELU.
known_unsupported.Sqrt: Not in the table. Rsqrt is supported, Sqrt is not.
known_unsupported.DepthToSpace: Not in the table. SpaceToDepth is supported, the inverse is not.
known_unsupported.TopK: Not in the table. Common in detection post-processing.
known_unsupported.NonMaxSuppression: Not in the table. Detection heads usually end up on CPU because of this.
